ios.desc:
Google Fi Wireless phone plans keep you connected with ultra-reliable 5G coverage, industry-leading security features, and plenty of perks at no extra cost.1 

Get ahead with top-priority data speeds.2 
Share your data to multiple devices – like laptops and tablets – with hotspot tethering and data-only SIMs.3,4 
Plus, enjoy instant coverage when you travel internationally.5

All plans include:

• Unlimited calls and texts 6 
• Built-in Google account security to help protect you and your information 
• Advanced spam call blocking powered by Google AI 7
• VPN by Google to help shield your online activity 8

Use this app to manage your plan: 

• Start your service
• Add people to your plan
• Find deals on new phones
• Switch to a different plan
• Check your data usage
• Get 24/7 customer support 

#1 carrier for overall satisfaction 
–  PCMag Readers’ Choice Awards

“A brilliantly designed app”
– Tom’s Guide

Note: You'll need to sign up for Google Fi Wireless before you can use the app. Google Fi is only available to US residents, and isn't intended for extended international use.

1  5G service not available in all areas. Speed and performance depend on factors like device configuration and capabilities, network traffic, location, signal strength and signal obstruction. Actual results may vary. For more information, visit g.co/fi/broadband-facts.

2 Google Fi Wireless is not subject to data traffic deprioritization during times of high network usage.

3 High-speed hotspot tethering up to 25 GB/person on Unlimited Standard and 50 GB/person on Unlimited Premium. Hotspot tethering counts towards your monthly high-speed data usage. 

4 High-speed data for cellular-enabled tablets and laptops, up to 50 GB/person on Unlimited Premium and up to 15 GB/person on Flexible, and 256 kbps after. Data counts towards your monthly high-speed data usage. You can connect up to four devices with data-only SIMs, and you can use the same SIM with multiple devices.

5 International high-speed data up to 50 GB/person on Unlimited Premium, and up to 15 GB/person on Flexible, and 256 kbps after. Data counts towards your monthly high-speed data usage. Not intended for international use over 90 consecutive days.

6 Rich Communication Services (RCS) messages are an item of your data usage. If you are on an unlimited data plan, you will not incur any additional charges by sending RCS messages.

7 Blocks spam known to Google. May not detect all spam calls.

8 Restrictions apply. Some
